response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), stats AS (SELECT fundflux, project_count, CAST(project_count AS REAL) / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(CAST(project_count AS REAL)) OVER () AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT fundflux, project_count, share, project_count - avg_count AS excess_over_avg FROM stats WHERE project_count > avg_count
